Why this work is safe to license

Reviewers and buyers can rely on every file in this library.

100% original, drawn by hand

Each design is drawn from scratch in code (Python + PIL) — shape by shape, colour by colour. Nothing is traced, copied, or taken from another artist's work.

No generative AI

No AI image tools were used for any file in this portfolio. These are hand-built digital graphics, so they carry no AI-content flags and no model-training concerns.

Clean of brands & marks

No logos, no trademarks, no watermarks anywhere in the library. The only lettering is the artist's own original wording, drawn as part of each poster design. Nothing here can trigger an IP complaint.

Print-ready resolution

Icons are delivered at 6000 × 6000 px and backgrounds and posters at 8000 × 5333 px, in sRGB JPEG — large enough for print, web and social use without upscaling.
